sources.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely ...
sources.snippet: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

sources.title: Recursive says AI built most of its new Flint coding model
sources.snippet: Recursive's new Flint coding model, built by its Eureka Machine AI, got a positive but narrow Wired test using benchmarks the company itself generated.

sources.title: Recursive Releases Flint, an Open-Weight 40B MoE Local Coding Model for ...
sources.snippet: Recursive Flint is a 40B MoE local coding model with 2.5B active parameters, scoring 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

sources.title: Flint AI Coding Model Hits 89.7% on SWE-Bench [2026]
sources.snippet: Recursive launches Flint, a 40B/2.5B open coding model scoring 89.7% on SWE-bench Pro v2, as Gemini 4 Argon and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash expand access.

sources.title: Introducing Flint - Recursive
sources.snippet: Building Flint was a practical test of Recursive's Eureka Machine, our system for large-scale automated AI research and development. Our Eureka Machine helped develop nearly every part of Flint's model-building stack, from data and training recipes to infrastructure and inference optimization.
